visual.name: bfusionPMOCommandCenter
visual.description: PMO command center over OnePlan plan insights: governance KPI cards with budget at risk, a project x rule-area heatmap, the lifecycle flow, question chips and decision cards with Teams / e-mail follow-up.

dataRoles.name: level1
dataRoles.description: Top level of the project list, e.g. DimPortfolio[Name].

dataRoles.name: level2
dataRoles.description: Second level, e.g. DimProgram[Name].

dataRoles.name: project
dataRoles.description: One row per project, e.g. DimProject[Name]. Required.

dataRoles.name: ruleArea
dataRoles.description: Heatmap columns, e.g. DimInsightRule[RuleArea]. Required.

dataRoles.name: stage
dataRoles.description: Current stage of the project, e.g. DimProject[ProcessStep]. Drives the lifecycle flow.

dataRoles.name: stageOrder
dataRoles.description: Number that orders the stages, e.g. DimProject[ProcessStepIndex].

dataRoles.name: stageStart
dataRoles.description: Date the project entered its stage, e.g. DimProject[ProcessStepStart]. Gives days in stage.

dataRoles.name: manager
dataRoles.description: e.g. DimProject[Manager_Value].

dataRoles.name: managerEmail
dataRoles.description: Enables the Teams and e-mail buttons on decisions.

dataRoles.name: projectLink
dataRoles.description: https URL of the plan (e.g. the OnePlan plan page). Adds an open-plan button.

dataRoles.name: checks
dataRoles.description: PMO | Checks. Required.

dataRoles.name: checksFailed
dataRoles.description: PMO | Checks Failed. Required.

dataRoles.name: problems
dataRoles.description: PMO | Problems (failed Level-30 checks).

dataRoles.name: warnings
dataRoles.description: PMO | Warnings (failed Level-20 checks).

dataRoles.name: advisories
dataRoles.description: PMO | Advisories (failed Level-10 checks).

dataRoles.name: complianceChecks
dataRoles.description: PMO | Compliance Checks.

dataRoles.name: compliancePassed
dataRoles.description: PMO | Compliance Checks Passed.

dataRoles.name: govScore
dataRoles.description: Per-project score 0-100, e.g. Average of DimProject[PMO Governance Score].

dataRoles.name: checkDetail
dataRoles.description: Text measure naming the broken rules, e.g. PMO | Check Result Detail or PMO | Failed Checks.

dataRoles.name: complianceDetail
dataRoles.description: Text measure naming the failed compliance checks, e.g. PMO | Failed Compliance Checks.

dataRoles.name: nextAction
dataRoles.description: PMO | Next Action.

dataRoles.name: budget
dataRoles.description: Project budget, e.g. Finance | Budget Cost. Feeds Budget at risk.

dataRoles.name: forecast
dataRoles.description: Project forecast or EAC. Adds the forecast overrun to Budget at risk.

dataRoles.name: lateTasks
dataRoles.description: Task | Active Late Tasks.

dataRoles.name: tsHours
dataRoles.description: Timesheet | Hours.

dataRoles.name: tsAwaiting
dataRoles.description: Timesheet | Awaiting Approval Hours.

dataRoles.name: lastStatusReport
dataRoles.description: Date of the project's latest submitted status report, e.g. PMO | Last Status Report Date.

dataRoles.name: openReports
dataRoles.description: Text measure listing the status reports not submitted after their period, as start|end|state; e.g. PMO | Unsubmitted Status Reports.

dataRoles.name: tsLateDetail
dataRoles.description: Text measure listing late resources as Name|days|missing or late, e.g. PMO | Timesheet Lateness Detail.

dataRoles.name: tooltips
dataRoles.description: Extra project-level measures shown in the cell detail.

dataRoles.name: licenseToken
dataRoles.description: Bind to the single-cell BFusionLicense[Key] column in your model

mode.description: Surface theme for the visual chrome. Auto follows the report theme's background.

background.description: Custom mode only. Plot and root background.

surface.description: Custom mode only. Header, toolbar, panels, tiles and tooltips.

textColor.description: Custom mode only. Primary text colour.

mutedColor.description: Custom mode only. Labels, captions and axis text.

ruleColor.description: Custom mode only. Separators, tile borders and axis lines.

areaOrder.description: Semicolon-separated rule areas. Areas not listed follow alphabetically.

defaultLimit.displayName: Default days allowed in a stage

gateStages.description: Semicolon-separated stage names that start with a gate, e.g. Approved;Execution

licenseKey.description: Paste your BFusion license key here. Contact info@bfusion.eu for a license.
